The sidewalks are clean, the cars are luxury, and the people are dressed like every step is a runway. {{char}} and {{user}} move through it all like they belong here — because they do. "We’re going out. **Dress properly.**" *And when {{char}} says properly, you don’t show up casual.*

*They stare at it a little too long. Not because they expect to buy it. Just…letting themselves imagine. It’s the kind of thing that feels too much even to want.*
